mappings.note: Factual recall from the prose text: what Muslims do in Muharram, as the lesson states it. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 because nothing here touches Yatindra Mishra's intent or style.
Content of the text -- Bismillah Khan's conduct during Muharram. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: it asks what the subject did, not what the writer meant by reporting it.
Recall of a stated prohibition (raag-raagini) on Muharram. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 because no appreciation of authorial craft is required.

Asks which image of Bismillah Khan the passage projects (sahaj maanaviya / dharm ke prati samarpit) -- that is appreciating the portrait the writer draws, not a fact in it. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1, which covers vishayvastu recall.
Why his eyes stay moist -- a stated cause in the text. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 since the 'why' is answered from content, not from the writer's viewpoint.
Recall of what Khan Sahib misses (malai barf, sangeet-sahitya, adab). Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: no bhasha-shaili judgement involved.

Meaning of 'sushir-vaadya' as used in the lesson -- a word's sense in context, which the frame files under bodh. Rejected C-H1.2 because no grammatical structure (sandhi/samas/vaachya) is being tested.
Where the shehnai is mentioned, per the text. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 -- recall of textual detail, not of the writer's purpose.
The comparison the lesson records (South Indian mangal vaadya). Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: the student recalls the comparison, he is not asked to appraise it as style.
Which language's folk songs mention the shehnai (Awadhi) -- stated content. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 for the same reason.
Identifies the term 'shaahenay' with the shehnai -- vocabulary of the text. Rejected C-H1.2, since this is a content term and not a grammar exercise.
Kashi's chief characteristic as the passage states it. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: the companion item that asks WHY the writer said this is the LO-2 one; this one only recalls the statement.
Explains why the writer calls Khan Sahib Kashi's 'nayaab heera' -- unpacking an authorial epithet and the Ganga-Jamuni message behind it. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1 because no fact of his life answers it.
The piece read as a statement on sampradayik sadbhav -- the writer's thesis. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1: the options are evidence, but the thing tested is the theme the author builds.
Why Kashi is CALLED a 'sanskriti ki paathshala' -- interpreting the writer's metaphor. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1, which would fit the plain 'Kashi kiski paathshala hai' recall item, not this 'kyon' form.
Recall of what the writer states about Kashi's people (shisht, vishisht boli) -- 'lekhak ne bataya' here is plain content. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 because no intent or style is being appraised.
When sehra-banna and nauha are played -- stated fact. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 as no authorial judgement is at stake.
Which figures the extract names (Ramdas, Maujuddin Khan, Pt Kanth Maharaj). Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 -- pure content inventory.
Who preserved Kashi's cultural heritage, per the text. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 because the answer is recalled, not interpreted.

Relationship of Paigambar Bakhsh Khan and Mitthan to Bismillah Khan -- a fact about the TEXT's subject, so it is content, not author biography. Rejected C-H1.3 at competency level, which is reserved for Yatindra Mishra's own life.
The Son river at Dumraon -- stated detail. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 for absence of any craft question.
Childhood name Amiruddin -- content about the subject of the piece. Rejected C-H1.3 competency: this is not the writer's biography.
The reed through which the shehnai is blown -- technical detail from the lesson. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 as no style question arises.
Identifying the shehnai as a sushir vaadya -- comprehension of the text's classification. Rejected C-H1.2, no grammatical category is involved.
Bharat Ratna as his highest honour -- fact from the lesson. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 because no interpretation of the writer is needed.
Recalls the 'sabse badi den' sentence the text itself supplies. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2: the verdict is quoted from the passage rather than reconstructed from the writer's stance.
Why he will remain a 'sangeet nayak' forever -- the writer's evaluative claim about his subject's lasting stature. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1 because no single stated fact settles it.
What the Sangeet Natak Akademi is and where -- an external referent the lesson supplies. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2, no authorial reading required.

Vaakya-bhed item (saral / sanyukt / mishra) -- the sentence from the lesson is only the carrier; the skill tested is grammatical structure. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1, which would treat the sentence's meaning rather than its form.
Tests the concept of Ganga-Jamuni sanskriti as the piece deploys it (odd-one-out). Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1 because the answer comes from grasping the writer's theme, not from a stated detail.

That Kashi's history was NOT made by religious or caste enmity is the writer's own composite thesis. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1: no sentence in the text states this negatively; it has to be inferred from his argument.
Death in Kashi held to be mangalmay -- stated in the lesson. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 as this is recall, while the 'kyon kaha' form of the same idea is the LO-2 one.

The writer's own figure of Baba Vishwanath and Bismillah Khan as 'poorak' -- an interpretive characterisation carrying the harmony theme. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1 because it is the author's construction, not an event.
What he asks of Khuda (a true sur) -- stated content. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2; the 'music as worship' reading is tested by other items, this one only recalls the request.
What Awadhi folk songs and chaiti mention -- fact from the text. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2, no craft appraisal.
Kashi's shastric name 'Anandkanan' -- recall. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 because the epithet is attributed to the shastras in the text, not coined by the writer.
Plain recall that Kashi is the paathshala of sanskriti. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2, which fits only the 'kyon kaha gaya' version of this question.
Ten days of mourning in Muharram -- numeric fact. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 as nothing authorial is probed.
Amiruddin's nanihaal is Kashi -- content about the subject. Rejected C-H1.3 competency, reserved for the writer's own life.
Who was delighted by Rasoolan/Batoolan's singing -- stated detail. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2; no interpretation of the writer is needed.
Sankat Mochan temple's location (Lanka, Varanasi) as given in the lesson. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 -- plain place recall.

Frames the lesson by its vidha -- whose 'vyakti chitra' it is. Recognising the genre and its subject is vidha ki prakriti, which sits under the writer-appreciation LO. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1 because it is about the piece as a composition, not about events inside it.
Which relative's house he had in Kashi (naana) -- content. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2, no craft question.
Which instrument is titled 'shah' among sushir vaadya -- recall. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 as the title is traditional, reported by the writer, not invented by him.
Where the shehnai is repeatedly mentioned (Awadhi folk song and chaiti). Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 -- straight recall.

Turns entirely on the kasturi-mrig image the writer applies to Khan Sahib; nothing in Khan Sahib's life answers it. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1 because the object of the question is an authorial simile, i.e. bhasha-shaili. NOTE: stem is garbled ('us vardaan tarah khojta hai').
Which Muslim festival is tied to him (Muharram) -- fact. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2, no authorial reading needed.
Whom Shia Muslims mourn in Muharram, per the text. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 for the same reason.
The athanni he earned at the Balaji temple -- stated detail. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2; nothing interpretive.
His personality as riyazi and swaadi -- traits the text states outright. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 because the student recalls the description rather than appraising how it is written.
What he would never give up (Kashi and the shehnai) -- content. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 as no writerly intent is tested.
Age at death (90) -- a fact about the TEXT's subject, hence content. Rejected C-H1.3 at competency level, which is for Yatindra Mishra's biography, not Bismillah Khan's.
The ancient music gathering in Kashi -- stated. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2, straight recall.
That the Kashi music event falls on Hanuman Jayanti -- fact. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 for absence of interpretation.
Whose songs drew Amiruddin to singing (Rasoolan/Batoolan Bai). Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 -- content recall.
What was contained in his shehnai, as the lesson lists it. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 because the list is given, not inferred from the writer's stance.
Why Dumraon is remembered in the shehnai world -- three stated reasons. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2 since the 'kyon' is answered from facts in the text.
Sense of 'sushir vaadya' in context. Rejected C-H1.2 -- a contextual word meaning, not a grammar item.
The title conferred on the shehnai -- recall. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-2, no appraisal of the writer's language.

Turns on recognising the writer's own coinage 'sangeetmay kachauri' for Kulsum's kachauri -- a bhasha-shaili flourish, not a fact about the food. Rejected C-H1.3-LO-1 because the distractors are all ordinary descriptors and only the stylistic phrase is correct.
